events.title: Weekly Devlog 2026-08-02
events.summary: This week was all about implementing the other three challenge types that I had planned. Rather than hard-coding them, I decided to rework them to be more dynamic. The biggest change is that challenge types are now defined using a JSON file (similar to stories, achievements, and music). The JSON specifies the color(s) of the capsule, its animations, and how it reacts to various player actions.
